consoleSteps.step: api.slack.com/apps → Create new app: templates offered include "AI agent" and "Starter app"; chose From a manifest
Manifest: name "Greenlight test", bot user, redirect_urls [Composio callback], bot scopes users:read team:read channels:read; workspace "greenlight"
App created instantly (App ID A0CEBJERHV3); Basic Information shows Client ID; Client Secret masked behind Show
Connect Link → Slack consent "Allow Greenlight test to access Slack". Composio default requested ~50 USER scopes (user_scope=calls:read … users:write) and no bot scopes
Owner clicked Allow → connected account ACTIVE; SLACK_FETCH_TEAM_INFO returned workspace "greenlight"

browser: User's own Google Chrome via Claude in Chrome; human signed in to Slack and clicked Allow. Secret moved via clipboard into the script; never printed or saved.
